scope: Equal-depth verification for a municipal park whose ordinary landscape becomes periodic civic infrastructure, a former national museum now used as ministry/event space, and a private museum whose current photography rule forces an exterior-first scene.

sources.supports: The municipality reports the second Sumaq Plantas festival at Parque de la Felicidad from 30 April to 3 May 2026, proving repeat periodic ecological-market use rather than a daily schedule.
A March 2026 Hora del Planeta program gathered residents and visitors in the park from afternoon into the lighting transition, corroborating civic/environmental occupation.
Municipal inventory places the park within San Borja's green-space system; it is historical design context and does not establish 2026 condition.
The former Museo de la Nación/sede central hosted the July 2026 Ruraq Maki edition, confirming large event occupation, makers, stands and public circulation.

sources.publisher: Zona Arqueológica Caral / Ministerio de Cultura
sources.supports: A 2026 monthly display on the second floor inserts limited public exhibition into an administrative building; occurrence and access must be checked for the shoot date.

The ministry explicitly describes the San Borja structure as what was the Museo de la Nación and records collection relocation/storage context, preventing the current building from being mislabeled as an ordinarily operating museum.
Current hours are Tuesday-Sunday 10:00-18:00 at Av. Pedro de Osma 421; interior photography/audiovisual recording is prohibited, while access routes and mediated visits are described.
The institution identifies the early-twentieth-century residence, gardens, stained glass and architectural fabric as part of the museum experience and its present cultural mission.
Current 2026 exhibitions and academic programming prove active institutional life but do not override the interior photography prohibition.

contradictions: Two 2026 municipal programs prove periodic civic and ecological occupation, not routine daily density or a future event window.
The municipal compendium is historical and cannot establish current bridge, lagoon, playground, amphitheater or maintenance condition.
Map claims of continuous opening are non-authoritative and remain VERIFY_BEFORE_ROUTE.
composition_questions: Can lagoon, bridge, amphitheater or path visibly distribute one ordinary or programmed environmental verb instead of supplying picturesque scenery?
Which reflection, ornamental bridge, temporary stall, crowd or residential edge makes the frame generic event/park coverage?
Does a low path-level position reveal how water, crossing and gathering zones cause movement, or is the event carrying all meaning?

source_truth.answer: Parque de la Felicidad is an active San Borja public park documented as host of repeated 2026 environmental/civic events; its precise built components and ordinary condition require field confirmation.

original_spatial_contract.answer: A municipal green/recreation system combines paths and landscape elements to support crossing, play, pause and gathering; historic inventory does not prove every present component.

current_life.answer: In verified events people exhibit, buy, diagnose plants, meet, listen and gather through a lighting transition; normal-day walking, play and maintenance remain field observations.

human_verbs_or_meaningful_absence.answer: Exhibit, browse, advise, gather, cross, pause and observe are evidenced. Empty amphitheater/path capacity can carry meaningful expectation only when spatial distribution remains legible.

architectural_causality.answer: Paths, water edge, bridge, lawns and gathering surfaces can separate movement from pause and transform landscape into civic infrastructure; exact causal device must be selected on site.

visual_forensic_saturation.answer: Lake/bridge reflection and colorful fair coverage dominate. The underused relation is a ground-level route where landscape geometry visibly assigns crossing, exchange and gathering.

light_material_geometry.answer: Late-day transition can separate water, bridge/path and occupied gathering areas; garúa can simplify the same layers. Attractive reflection without spatial causality fails.

position_then_optics.answer: Test path-level water/bridge tangent, amphitheater-to-path reverse and low edge-to-gathering diagonal. Start 35 mm for system, 50 mm for one exchange and 85 mm only if route context survives.

moment_logistics_ethics.answer: Verify maintenance, hours and event authorization same day; avoid identifying children, blocking paths or turning vendors into spectacle; completed events are never route promises.

one_frame_contest_test.answer: Passes when landscape architecture visibly converts environmental/social activity into ordered crossing and gathering. Scenic water, bridge portrait or event crowd alone fails.

A_STRUCTURE.edge_guards: Exclude decorative clutter and clipped bridge

C_ANTI_POSTAL.edge_guards: No perfect reflection or stage branding

D_LIGHT_MATERIAL.light: Late low sun or blue hour

E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.expected_action: Approach, crossing and exchange occupy three layers

contradictions: The canonical name retains Museo de la Nación history, but current official language identifies the structure as the Ministry's central headquarters/what was the museum; ordinary museum operation must not be claimed.
Ruraq Maki is a completed periodic event and the monthly Caral display must be confirmed for the date; neither supplies a permanent public-access window.
Administrative security and adjacent GTN/BNP/LCC flows may prevent interior or threshold photography.
composition_questions: Can the former museum's monumental circulation visibly reorganize a present maker market, monthly display or administrative/public encounter?
Which stand grid, banner, security barrier, neighboring landmark or crowd erases the inherited institutional volume?
Does a permitted ramp/hall/threshold position make former-museum-to-ministry transformation legible in one frame, or is the story available only in the caption?

source_truth.answer: The San Borja building is the Ministry of Culture central headquarters in what was the Museo de la Nación and remains capable of large public cultural events.

original_spatial_contract.answer: Monumental halls, ramps/floors and controlled thresholds were organized for national-scale collection display and public circulation before administrative conversion.

current_life.answer: Staff administer and work while periodic makers, visitors and heritage displays occupy selected halls/floors; exact public program and access are date-dependent.

human_verbs_or_meaningful_absence.answer: Make, display, sell, teach, browse, queue, work and encounter are evidenced. Empty monumental circulation between events can reveal the mismatch between public-museum scale and controlled administration.

architectural_causality.answer: Large halls, ramps/floors and entry controls distribute dense temporary exchange or restrict ordinary public movement, making reuse itself spatially visible.

visual_forensic_saturation.answer: Monumental façade and event-stand coverage dominate. The underused relation is inherited museum-scale circulation meeting current administrative security or intergenerational making.

light_material_geometry.answer: High-volume interior light can separate concrete/structure, circulation and temporary occupation; exterior hard light risks mere monumentality. Human-use geometry must remain primary.

position_then_optics.answer: Test authorized hall diagonal, controlled entrance queue and second-floor public/office threshold. Start 35 mm for inherited volume, 50 mm for exchange and avoid 85 mm if context or privacy is lost.

moment_logistics_ethics.answer: Confirm event/display occurrence and written photography permission, obey security, avoid documents/screens/artwork reproduction and never infer open museum access from a completed event.

one_frame_contest_test.answer: Passes when former national-museum circulation visibly governs current administration or cultural exchange. Monumental façade, craft-market documentation or historical caption fails.

A_STRUCTURE.position: Authorized/public threshold aligning entry control, monumental void and ramp/floor sequence

B_HABITAR.position: Authorized hall edge where maker/visitor exchange follows structural bay or ramp
B_HABITAR.edge_guards: No product/artwork close-up or identifiable child

C_ANTI_POSTAL.position: Permitted second-floor threshold joining office control and small public display
C_ANTI_POSTAL.expected_action: Worker and visitor negotiate same inherited corridor
C_ANTI_POSTAL.edge_guards: No screen, document or object reproduction

D_LIGHT_MATERIAL.position: Authorized oblique where structural surface, ramp shadow and temporary occupation overlap

E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.position: Authorized diagonal joining controlled entrance, former-museum circulation and present exchange
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.expected_action: Queue, making and movement occupy distinct zones

contradictions: The museum is currently open Tuesday-Sunday, but its visitor rules prohibit interior photography; paid admission does not authorize a competition photograph.
The canonical label joins house and avenue, yet one frame must prove their spatial relation rather than depend on a walking-route caption.
Current programs prove active institutional life but do not make event participants or interiors photographable without separate permission.
composition_questions: Can the avenue approach, garden setback and museum gate show a former private residence becoming a controlled public cultural threshold?
Which traffic, parked vehicle, ornate façade detail, garden foliage or visitor queue reduces the image to Barranco heritage tourism?
Does a public exterior position reveal avenue-to-garden-to-house depth with a real arrival verb, or would interior access be doing all narrative work?

source_truth.answer: The active Museo Pedro de Osma occupies an early-twentieth-century residence and gardens at Av. Pedro de Osma 421, with current published hours and strict interior photography prohibition.

original_spatial_contract.answer: A private eclectic residence used garden setback, gate, paths, stained glass and rooms to stage a gradual avenue-to-domestic arrival.

current_life.answer: Visitors arrive, buy admission, join mediated routes, study and attend programs; interior photography remains prohibited and event access does not imply photographic permission.

human_verbs_or_meaningful_absence.answer: Approach, queue, enter, mediate, learn, exit and walk the avenue are evidenced. A closed/quiet garden threshold may show controlled public expectation without photographing inside.

architectural_causality.answer: Avenue, gate, garden path, house entrance and mediated interior route convert a former private arrival sequence into regulated museum access.

visual_forensic_saturation.answer: Ornate façade, stained glass, collection and garden beauty dominate. The underused relation is the public avenue meeting a layered but controlled cultural threshold.

light_material_geometry.answer: Filtered garden light can separate gate, path and house planes; low sun can articulate threshold depth. Ornamental detail without conversion/use fails.

position_then_optics.answer: Test public avenue-to-gate diagonal, side-street garden-depth tangent and exit-facing reverse. Start 35 mm for layered approach, 50 mm for arrival and use 85 mm only without looking through private/interior openings.

moment_logistics_ethics.answer: Default to public exterior; do not photograph inside under current rules, request explicit professional/competition authorization for any exception, avoid faces and never block the gate or accessible route.

one_frame_contest_test.answer: Passes when the inherited residential threshold visibly channels contemporary public museum arrival from the avenue. Mansion portrait, interior rule breach or caption-built neighborhood route fails.

A_STRUCTURE.edge_guards: Exclude cars, clipped gate and ornamental close-up

B_HABITAR.expected_action: Adults approach, pause and enter through distinct layers
